from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from threading import Event,Lock
import json,hashlib,re,requests
OUT=Path("reports/research/510300_corporate_loan_weighted_rate_source_qualification_v1")
proto=json.loads((OUT/"protocol.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
initial=json.loads((OUT/"release_probe_receipts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
new=json.loads((OUT/"remaining_release_receipts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
releases={x["quarter"]:x for x in initial}
releases.update({x["quarter"]:x for x in new})
assert sorted(releases)==proto["fixed_quarters"]
jobs=[]
for quarter in proto["fixed_quarters"]:
    row=releases[quarter]
    soup=BeautifulSoup(Path(row["path"]).read_bytes(),"html.parser")
    choices=[]
    for a in soup.find_all("a",href=True):
        href=a["href"]
        if urlparse(href).path.lower().endswith(".pdf"):
            from urllib.parse import urljoin
            choices.append({"title":a.get_text(" ",strip=True),"url":urljoin(row["final_url"],href)})
    assert len(choices)==1,(quarter,choices)
    assert urlparse(choices[0]["url"]).hostname=="www.pbc.gov.cn"
    assert len(row["displayed_datetime_candidates"])==1
    jobs.append({"quarter":quarter,"url":choices[0]["url"],"pdf_link_title":choices[0]["title"],
                 "release_page_path":row["path"],"displayed_published_at":row["displayed_datetime_candidates"][0]})
assert len(jobs)==16
assert not (OUT/"pdf_receipts.json").exists()
(OUT/"固定16季度PDF取得计划.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "started_at":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),"jobs":jobs,
    "requests_before_this_batch":19,"planned_pdf_requests":16,"planned_total_requests":35,
    "request_categories_before":{"fixed_release":16,"directory_or_method":3},
    "new_equity_labels":0,"new_fits":0,"new_accounts":0},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
stopped=Event(); budget_lock=Lock()
total_response_bytes=sum(p.stat().st_size for p in (OUT/"sources").iterdir() if p.is_file())
def fetch(job):
    global total_response_bytes
    receipt={**job,"request_role":"FIXED_PDF","attempts":0}
    if stopped.is_set():
        receipt["status"]="NOT_ATTEMPTED_HOST_OR_BYTE_BUDGET_STOP"; return receipt
    receipt["attempts"]=1
    receipt["requested_at"]=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
    try:
        r=requests.get(job["url"],headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"},timeout=(10,25),stream=True)
        receipt.update({"status_code":r.status_code,"final_url":r.url,"content_type":r.headers.get("Content-Type")})
        if r.status_code in (403,429): stopped.set()
        chunks=[]; size=0
        for chunk in r.iter_content(65536):
            size+=len(chunk)
            with budget_lock:
                total_response_bytes+=len(chunk)
                if total_response_bytes>proto["combined_original_response_max_bytes"]:
                    stopped.set(); raise ValueError("合计原响应超过已登记字节预算")
            if size>proto["per_pdf_max_bytes"]: stopped.set(); raise ValueError("单PDF超过已登记字节预算")
            chunks.append(chunk)
        raw=b"".join(chunks); r.close()
        valid=r.status_code==200 and raw.startswith(b"%PDF-")
        suffix=".pdf" if valid else "_response.bin"
        p=OUT/"sources"/(job["quarter"]+suffix); assert not p.exists(); p.write_bytes(raw)
        receipt.update({"path":str(p).replace("\\","/"),"bytes":len(raw),
            "sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"successfully_received":True,"valid_pdf_header":valid})
    except Exception as error:
        receipt.update({"successfully_received":False,"error_type":type(error).__name__,"error":str(error),"valid_pdf_header":False})
    receipt["completed_at"]=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
    return receipt
receipts=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
    futures=[pool.submit(fetch,job) for job in jobs]
    for future in as_completed(futures):
        row=future.result(); receipts.append(row)
        (OUT/"pdf_receipts_running.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipts,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
        print("原PDF取得：",row["quarter"],row.get("status_code"),row.get("bytes"),row.get("valid_pdf_header"),flush=True)
receipts.sort(key=lambda x:x["quarter"])
(OUT/"pdf_receipts.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipts,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print("固定PDF取得完成，合格PDF：",sum(x.get("valid_pdf_header",False) for x in receipts),flush=True)
